summary: Nuvectis Pharma, Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) announcing a reduction in the amount available for sales under its existing Sales Agreement with Leerink Partners LLC from an undisclosed prior amount to $5 million, and a suspension of further sales under that prospectus until a new prospectus supplement or registration statement is filed. The filing is a routine disclosure of a change in its at-the-market equity program and does not constitute a special-situation event such as a capital return, restructuring, or other transformative transaction. No deal terms, prices, or premiums are involved. There is no risk-arb angle; the filing is merely an administrative update.
